description:
Every loot source (crates, NPCs, barrels). One page of loot sources, alphabetical. Each carries `id`, `name` (Facepunch's own loot-table name, e.g.
`Elite Tier Crate`), `drop_count` (how many distinct items it can drop) and `icons` (the icons of its four
likeliest drops). Fetch the full drop table with `/loot-tables/{id}`. Cached for 30 minutes.
name: list_loot_sources
title: Every loot source (crates, NPCs, barrels)
